labels.cache:
Request Cache
has a cached result?
labels.t_full:
Resources full, send
reject to the circuit breaker for statistics
labels.t_exc: Send exception event to the circuit breaker for statistics
labels.t_ok: Execution succeeded: return the result and also send it to the circuit breaker for statistics
labels._desc: A Hystrix command call checks the request cache, the circuit breaker and the thread pool or semaphore in turn, falls back on rejection or error, and reports statistics to the circuit breaker.
